decks.notes: The main concept of this UWx Control deck is to use powerful planeswalkers like Narset, Parter of Veils and Teferi, Time Raveler, as well as efficient removal spells like Swords to Plowshares and Prismatic Ending, to control the game and disrupt the opponent's game plan. The deck aims to control the board and hand through counterspells like Force of Will and Force of Negation, while also generating value with cards like Shark Typhoon. The inclusion of cards like Dress Down and The Wandering Emperor helps to further disrupt the opponent's strategy and maintain control of the game.

The deck focuses on quickly assembling the necessary cards to cast Doomsday and win the game by stacking the library in a specific order that sets up a game-winning combo using Thassa's Oracle. The deck features a high number of cantrips and tutors to dig for key pieces, along with disruption in the form of Thoughtseize, Force of Will, and Duress to protect the combo. The deck aims to efficiently win the game in a single turn while keeping opponents off balance with disruption.

This deck aims to control the game using a mix of disruptive spells, removal, and efficient creatures like Stoneforge Mystic and Baleful Strix. The key strategy revolves around leveraging the card advantage from Yorion, Sky Nomad's ability to blink multiple permanents, as well as the flexibility of cards like Recruiter of the Guard and Spellseeker to find key answers or threats. By generating incremental advantages and disrupting the opponent's game plan, this deck aims to outvalue and outmaneuver the opponent in the long game.

The deck focuses on disrupting opponents' strategies with tax effects like Thalia, Guardian of Thraben and Rishadan Port while applying pressure with creatures like Stoneforge Mystic and Flickerwisp. It also utilizes cards like Karakas and Phyrexian Revoker to control the board and protect its own threats. The deck's win condition is often achieved through efficient removal spells like Swords to Plowshares, backed up by powerful equipment like Sword of Fire and Ice and Umezawa's Jitte. The overall strategy is to disrupt opponents' game plan while deploying a quick and efficient aggro offense.

The main concept of this deck is to disrupt the opponent's mana base with cards like Blood Moon and Magus of the Moon, while also deploying aggressive threats like Goblin Rabblemaster and Legion Warboss to pressure the opponent. Trinisphere and Chalice of the Void further disrupt the opponent's game plan, while cards like Fury provide removal and Den of the Bugbear and Sokenzan, Crucible of Defiance offer additional utility and card advantage. The deck aims to lock down the opponent's resources and quickly close out the game with its aggressive creatures.

This deck aims to overwhelm the opponent quickly with aggressive creatures and efficient spells. It focuses on tempo and disruption, utilizing cards like Daze and Wasteland to disrupt the opponent's game plan while deploying threats like Delver of Secrets and Murktide Regent to quickly end the game. The deck also includes card draw and selection like Brainstorm and Ponder to ensure consistency and smooth gameplay. Overall, the deck's strategy revolves around applying pressure early and maintaining control of the game through a combination of aggression and disruption.

The deck focuses on quickly playing threats like Delver of Secrets, Murktide Regent, and Dragon's Rage Channeler while using disruptive spells like Daze and Force of Will to protect them. The deck aims to control the board with cards like Lightning Bolt and Wasteland while also generating card advantage with cards like Mishra's Bauble and Ponder. The goal is to apply early pressure and disrupt the opponent's game plan, ultimately overwhelming them with aggressive creatures and efficient spells. It aims to be fast and proactive, constantly forcing the opponent to react to its threats while also controlling the game.

The main concept of this deck is to utilize cards that synergize well with Yorion, Sky Nomad as a companion, creating a resilient and versatile aggro strategy. The deck focuses on utilizing cards like Solitude, Teferi, Time Raveler, Force of Will, and Spellseeker to control the board and disrupt the opponent's game plan. By combining powerful creatures like Ice-Fang Coatl and Eternal Witness with efficient removal spells like Swords to Plowshares and Prismatic Ending, the deck aims to overwhelm opponents with consistent threats and disruption, ultimately leading to victory.

The main concept of this Legacy control deck is to use Karn, the Great Creator and Karn, Scion of Urza alongside cards like Trinisphere, Chalice of the Void, and Defense Grid to disrupt the opponent's game plan and control the board. The deck also utilizes mana acceleration through cards like Grim Monolith and Mox Diamond to quickly ramp into powerful threats. Additionally, cards like Expedition Map and Urza's Saga provide additional utility and synergy within the deck to further establish control and create advantages throughout the game.

The main concept of this deck is to aggressively use powerful cards like Death's Shadow and Murktide Regent to apply pressure on the opponent while controlling the game with disruptive spells like Thoughtseize and Force of Will. The deck also includes efficient cantrips and card selection tools like Brainstorm and Ponder to ensure consistency and smooth draws. Additionally, the deck includes a strong creature package with Delver of Secrets and Dragon's Rage Channeler to further pressure the opponent. The mana base is streamlined to support the deck's color requirements and maximize efficiency.

The deck focuses on quickly building up a board presence and controlling the opponent's resources through counterspells and removal spells. Using efficient creatures like Dragon's Rage Channeler and Murktide Regent, along with disruptive spells like Daze and Force of Will, the deck aims to apply pressure on the opponent while disrupting their game plan. The inclusion of cards like Brazen Borrower and True-Name Nemesis provide additional threats and protection, allowing the player to maintain tempo and secure a victory through a mix of aggression and control.

The deck aims to quickly cheat out high-cost creatures like Emrakul, the Aeons Torn and Griselbrand by using cards like Show and Tell and Sneak Attack. The deck also includes cards like Omniscience to allow for casting multiple spells in a turn without paying their mana cost. The deck runs a lot of cantrips like Ponder and Preordain, as well as counterspells like Daze and Force of Will to protect the combo pieces. It also includes lands that can produce multiple mana to help ramp into casting the big creatures early in the game.

The deck focuses on using disruptive spells and creatures to control the board while applying pressure with efficient threats. It combines counterspells, removal, and card advantage to disrupt the opponent's game plan, while leveraging tempo plays to maintain board advantage. The inclusion of Faerie Mastermind adds another dimension to the deck, providing additional card advantage and a powerful flying threat. Overall, the deck aims to outmaneuver the opponent and win through a combination of efficient threats and disruptive spells.

This deck focuses on utilizing artifact synergies and efficient mana acceleration to quickly overwhelm opponents with a combination of disruptive spells and powerful creatures. By controlling the board with cards like Chalice of the Void and Force of Will while generating card advantage with cards like Mishra's Bauble and Thought Monitor, the deck aims to maintain a strong presence on the battlefield while pressuring the opponent's life total. The inclusion of key artifacts like Urza's Bauble and Mox Opal, along with standout creatures like Emry, Lurker of the Loch, helps ensure consistency and flexibility in different game situations.

The main focus of this deck is to utilize the Mystic Forge combo alongside multiple artifact mana ramp cards, such as Basalt Monolith and Grim Monolith, to generate infinite mana and card draw. This combo is further supported by cards like Lion's Eye Diamond and Echo of Eons to continuously fuel the engine. Additionally, the inclusion of Karn, the Great Creator allows for utility in searching for key artifacts, while Defense Grid helps protect the combo from disruption. The deck aims to quickly assemble its pieces and overwhelm the opponent with a powerful and unstoppable engine.

The deck focuses on utilizing Mystic Forge to combo off quickly and efficiently by using cards like Basalt Monolith and Lion's Eye Diamond to generate mana, while also using Mesmeric Orb to mill through the deck faster. Karn, the Great Creator is used to tutor for key artifacts, and Defense Grid helps protect the combo from disruption. The deck also includes cards like Voltaic Key and Manifold Key to untap artifacts and generate more mana. Overall, the deck aims to set up a quick win condition utilizing the synergy between artifact cards.
